title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw a circle with a center at coordinates [0.0438, 0.0438] and a radius of 0.0438. In the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a slightly smaller radius of 0.0427. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0875 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be a length and width of 0.0875 units and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circles
center = (0.0438, 0.0438)
radius_outer = 0.0438
radius_inner = 0.0427

# Create the outer circle
r = r.center(*center).circle(radius_outer)

# Create the inner circle (for the rounded top and bottom)
r = r.circle(radius_inner)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical object
extrude_depth = 0.75
r = r.extrude(extrude_depth)

# The final model is stored in 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0438, 0.0438)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0438)  # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0424)  # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
